sources.observation: The head rises above pale eroded chest ledges. Separate rounded paws surround a small rounded stela. The headdress extends sideways beyond the face and leaves the narrow neck visible.

Kapp south elevation establishes the long low back, elevated rear haunch, narrow neck transition, forward face profile and low forepaw tops. The scale and native map controls guide the section stations.
Named way 540058405 and its parts define a 75 m plan envelope, lower forepaw separation and head position. The model faces east. Wall 484067034 bounds the enclosure.

limitations: The 1:50 survey elevation and mapped perimeter constrain the profile and footprint. The individual masonry blocks, minor rock grooves and facial erosion are authored estimates.
The enclosure floor uses an approximately 20 m datum based on the survey scale. Its rim uses retained coarse Terrarium heights. Nearby temples and their paving remain separate.
The Dream Stela uses its mapped position and silhouette. The inscriptions and internal passages are outside the model scope.
